strings.about.body:
This project was born from a certain faith and a simple desire to help.

NotLight is an open workspace for visual boards, notes, resources, and extensible modules. I hope it can be especially useful to school and university students, as well as young teachers. I know how difficult it can be to understand mathematics and other subjects, and I wanted to create a tool that could make that journey at least a little easier. That said, NotLight is open to anyone who wishes to use it.

One of the core ideas behind the project is that the materials people create should not be permanently tied to a single workspace. NotLight supports importing and exporting boards, notes, and resources, uses CAS with SHA-256 to avoid storing unnecessary duplicate resources, and includes a prototype architecture for creating and importing separate modules.

The idea behind NotLight existed long before its first public version, but most of its technical implementation was created in less than two weeks of intensive work alongside AI. I determined the architecture and direction of development, set tasks, and reviewed the results, while the actual code was written by AI.

At the moment, a ready-to-use build is available only for Windows. Over time, I would like to add support for Linux, macOS and, if it proves practical, mobile operating systems as well, but I cannot promise any specific timeline yet.

The project is still very young, and I simply could not test everything that is already in it. There are almost certainly bugs — so if you encounter something that does not work as it should, I would be grateful if you let me know.

strings.settings.monitors.title: Performance monitors
strings.settings.monitors.unsupported: Unavailable on this platform / with the current rendering backend.
strings.settings.palette.custom_hint: Custom colors apply immediately. Reset restores the selected base palette.
strings.settings.palette.description: The palette is semantic: one color set controls backgrounds, surfaces, text, accents, and interface states.
strings.settings.palette.preset_help: Choose a built-in palette, the working custom palette, or one of your saved presets.
strings.settings.palette.saved_help: Save the current colors under your own name. Saving the same name again updates the existing preset.
strings.settings.palette.title: Color palette
strings.settings.performance.apply_next_board: Budgets apply the next time a board is opened. They are locked on an open board so heavy pools are not rebuilt in the middle of work.
strings.settings.performance.board_budget_help: How many objects of different types may be rendered in detail inside the camera area at the same time.
strings.settings.performance.description: Budgets limit active work and detail, but never delete objects from the board.
strings.settings.performance.drawing_quality_hel: Controls stroke smoothing and spray density. Higher detail uses more CPU/GPU.
strings.settings.performance.frame_rate_descript: NotLight frame pacing policy. Operating-system, driver and firmware power limits remain outside the application.
strings.settings.performance.full_note_card_rend: For lightweight board notes, lowers LOD restrictions and enables an expanded retained Markdown render: more blocks, code lines, tables, and formulas. Intended for powerful PCs; canonical Markdown is unchanged.
strings.settings.performance.locked: These settings are fixed when a board opens. Return to the Hub to change them safely.
strings.settings.performance.materialized_ui_hel: Limit for heavy materialized controls layered over DOD data.
strings.settings.performance.module_surfaces_hel: Maximum number of live interactive modules on a board. When the limit is exceeded, the least recently activated module sleeps while its state stays preserved.
strings.settings.performance.note_embed_live_med: Maximum simultaneously active audio/video players inside note Reading/Preview. When exceeded, older embed players stop while canonical Markdown and resources stay unchanged.
strings.settings.performance.note_embed_rich_pre: Show images, audio waveforms, video posters and PDF pages directly inside notes. On slower hardware, disabling this keeps compact cards that still open through the Library.
strings.settings.performance.note_workspace_surf: Maximum number of interactive note workspaces kept live on a board. When the limit is exceeded, the least recently used workspace sleeps while tabs and canonical note state stay preserved.
strings.settings.performance.prefer_maximum_fps_: Removes NotLight's internal FPS limit and disables V-Sync so the engine can render as fast as possible. This may increase heat and battery use; the app cannot override Windows, BIOS/EC or GPU-driver power limits.
strings.settings.performance.profile_help: Profiles provide safe budget values. Custom mode enables manual tuning.
strings.settings.performance.texture_cache_help: Target memory budget for cached images and derived previews.
strings.settings.performance.title: Performance
strings.settings.performance.video_players_help: Maximum number of videos decoded concurrently on the board.
strings.settings.storage.auto_video_help: After import, a video enters the background queue. The original is kept until you choose to delete it.
strings.settings.storage.copy_done: Done: {count} files copied. Restart NotLight. The old library was kept as a backup.
strings.settings.storage.copy_done_restart: Prepared {count} resource files. Target: {path}. The source stays active until a safe shutdown; NotLight will copy and verify the latest changes again, switch to the new location, and remove the old library.
strings.settings.storage.copying: Preparing and verifying the Resource Library move… do not close the application.
strings.settings.storage.copying_modules: Preparing and byte-verifying the Module Library move…
strings.settings.storage.cpu_help: Eco for background work; Balanced is faster; Maximum lets FFmpeg use available threads without a NotLight limit.
strings.settings.storage.description: Choose where NotLight stores boards, resources, and modules. You can attach an existing store or safely move the current one to another drive.
strings.settings.storage.existing_found: An existing library was found. Restart NotLight to switch to it.
strings.settings.storage.existing_found_restart: Verified Resource Library prepared at {path}. On a clean NotLight exit, the latest changes are copied and verified again; the new location becomes active on the next launch.
strings.settings.storage.library_help: You can choose a parent folder, the NotLightLibrary folder itself, or a legacy library folder. A move copies and verifies every resource/blob first, then removes the old library only after the new location is committed.
strings.settings.storage.modules_copy_done_resta: Prepared and verified {count} module files. Target: {path}. On safe shutdown NotLight will synchronize again, switch to the new location, and remove the old Module Library.
strings.settings.storage.modules_existing_restar: Verified Module Library prepared at {path}. A clean exit performs a final copy/verification; the new location becomes active on the next launch.
strings.settings.storage.modules_help: You can choose a parent folder, the NotLightModules folder itself, or a legacy modules folder. A move copies and verifies first, then removes the old module library only after the new location is committed.
strings.settings.storage.prepare_failed: Could not prepare the new storage location.
strings.settings.storage.prepare_modules_failed: Could not prepare the new Module Library location.
strings.settings.storage.same_location: This is already the current location.
strings.settings.storage.title: Data storage
strings.settings.storage.video_help: FFmpeg runs as a separate process. Limiting CPU reduces laptop heat at the cost of longer encoding.
strings.settings.storage.wait_import: Wait for resource import to finish before moving the library.
strings.settings.storage.wait_video: Wait for video compression to finish, or cancel it, before moving the library.
strings.settings.subtitle: Controls, interface, audio, and performance in NotLight
strings.settings.title: Settings
strings.settings.window.description: Use a regular, maximized, or full-screen window.
strings.settings.window.title: Window mode
strings.voice.error.import: Could not add the voice note to the Resource Library
strings.voice.error.input_disabled: Microphone recording is disabled in project settings
strings.voice.error.no_signal: The recording contains no detectable audio signal. Check that a microphone is connected and microphone access is allowed in system settings.
strings.voice.error.save: Could not save the voice note
strings.voice.error.temp_dir: Could not create the temporary recording folder
strings.voice.permission.body: NotLight uses the microphone only when you explicitly record a voice note. The recording is saved as a normal audio resource in your local Resource Library and is not sent over the network.
strings.voice.permission.privacy_note: Your choice is remembered in NotLight’s local settings. System microphone access is still controlled by Windows.
strings.voice.permission.project_input_warning: This running Godot instance reports that audio input is disabled. It should be enabled by the project; after updating the project files, fully restart the project. You can also open the system microphone settings below.
strings.voice.permission.system_settings_failed: Could not open the system microphone settings.
strings.voice.permission.title: Microphone access
strings.voice.stop_help: Finish recording and add the note to the Resource Library
strings.settings.storage.boards_help: Your boards and board index live here. You can attach an existing NotLight store or move boards to another folder. A move copies and verifies first, then removes the old board data only after the new location is committed.
strings.settings.storage.prepare_boards_failed: Could not prepare the new board storage location.
strings.settings.storage.boards_existing_restart: Existing board storage prepared: {path}. It will become active after a safe shutdown and the next launch.
strings.settings.storage.boards_copy_done_restar: Prepared {count} board files. Target: {path}. On safe shutdown NotLight will verify again, switch to the new location, and remove the old board data.
strings.settings.storage.existing_adopt_restart: Existing storage found: {path}. It will be connected without overwriting its data after a safe shutdown and the next launch.
strings.settings.storage.overlap_error: The new and current storage locations must not be inside one another. Choose a separate folder.
strings.settings.storage.existing_invalid: The selected folder looks like existing storage but failed validation: %s
strings.settings.storage.populated_conflict: Both the current and selected storage locations contain different user data. NotLight will not merge or overwrite them automatically. Back them up first and select an empty folder or a store containing the same data.
strings.settings.storage.destination_changed: The prepared storage changed after it was selected. Migration was cancelled to avoid overwriting newer data.
strings.settings.storage.boards_folder_missing: The storage does not contain a boards folder.
strings.settings.storage.board_invalid: A board is damaged or incomplete: %s
strings.settings.storage.cleanup_failed: The new storage location is already active, but the old data could not be removed: %s. It was kept as a safety backup; you can delete it manually after checking the new location.
